datasets.name: Landslide inventory of La Liboriana river basin
datasets.verbatim: In this study, the landslide inventory in the basin, documented in Aristizábal-Giraldo and Ruiz-Vásquez (2023) was used.

datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR Digital Terrain Model (DTM)
datasets.verbatim: using a 12.5-m spatial resolution Digital Terrain Model (DTM) from ALOS PALSAR data provided by the Alaska Satellite Facility (https://asf.alaska.edu/data-sets/sar-data-sets/alos-palsar)

datasets.name: Geology maps (1:100,000)
datasets.verbatim: Also, derived lithological data for the study area by digitalization from 1:100,000 geology maps provided by the Colombian Geological Service (SGC) was used.

datasets.name: Sentinel-1A wide-swath SAR data
datasets.source: European Copernicus program of the European Space Agency—ESA
datasets.verbatim: landslides over the study area were analysed using ascending and descending orbits of Sentinel-1A wide-swath SAR data provided by the European Copernicus program of the European Space Agency—ESA (https://www.esa.int)... The data were obtained from the Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF) platform (https://www.asf.alaska.edu)

datasets.name: RapidEye-1 basic optical image
datasets.verbatim: a high resolution (6.5-m pixel) RapidEye-1 basic optical image (07/24/2015) acquired from Planet Labs (Planet Labs 2018)

methods.name: U-Net
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation network based on a fully connected convolution network, featuring an encoder path for low-level representations and a decoder path for high-level representations and reconstruction. It uses 3x3 convolutional layers, ReLU activation, max-pooling in the encoder, and up-sampling in the decoder to produce per-pixel landslide probability maps.
methods.verbatim: The U-Net model is an image semantic segmentation network based on a fully connected convolution network (Ronneberger et al. 2015).

availability.author_statement: Data will be made available on special request to the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the custom U-Net code is not provided or linked. While some input datasets are accessible via external providers, the lack of code and direct inventory access prevents reproducibility.
